scope: C0 queue (arms, grade, arm loop) hub and exact pinned-container CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: arm-control-replies
leaves.replaces: The engine control client replies to native_progress, native_stage_local and release_auto_arm
leaves.equivalence: The question is what the arm does with each reply: order, resume on refusal, refusal of a reply that does not prove the selection. The reply fields are the real _stage_control and release replies; test_alpha_c0_queue.Arm reads the same fields through the real endpoint, session and driver.

leaves.name: arm-scale-workload
leaves.equivalence: The question is which manifest, selection and declared standing budget the exact arm command sends through the real client and control plane. Only sizes and times are reduced, as held-f's workload() does.
leaves.cannot_prove: A 65,445-token prompt end to end; a real stage chunk (e3_alpha_c0_probe.py runs that on a connected Core; the box runs it for real)

leaves.name: stage-arm-grade-synthetic-run
leaves.replaces: A real box run: eight arm records with spans, stage counters and output digests, and the engine log those spans select
leaves.equivalence: Progress lines come from the real nm.ProgressTrace emitters through StageEmit, which writes each path's reply pattern: serial, four ranks answer every command; local, a command's own stage ranks answer, a non-target rank's row has replied 0 as executor_hooks writes it. e3_alpha_c0_probe.py runs the real driver's lines through the same join.
leaves.cannot_prove: The real speed, decode ratio, memory or numerics

leaves.name: stage-line-format
leaves.replaces: flash-s5 stage-local lines in the followed engine log
leaves.equivalence: The test line has the fields stage_progress._stage_line logs. test_e3_stage_local and e3_alpha_c0_probe.py read the real line with the same parser.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the docker log path keeps the line whole; the box run does

leaves.name: memory-lines
leaves.replaces: flash-s5 memory receipts from the workers
leaves.equivalence: The format is the recorded held-f line, pinned verbatim by test_memory_receipts_read_the_recorded_line.
leaves.cannot_prove: That C0 stays within the free-memory margin; that is the box gate, reported, proposed as 0 OOMs and min free >= base - 2 MiB

leaves.name: numerics-output-rows
leaves.replaces: Sampled tokens of the fresh and append requests and standing stream digests of a real run
leaves.equivalence: The comparison is over declared token lists and digests built by the real stream_digests; identity is structural.
leaves.cannot_prove: That equal sampled tokens mean equal tensors; the box compares tokens only (logprobs are refused native). The per-rank work proof is tools/c0_bit_identity.py, on CPU

leaves.name: arm-loop-clients
leaves.replaces: e3_alpha_c0_box.py arm and e3_native39_trunk_checks.py at the bash seam
leaves.equivalence: alpha-perf's stubs (test_alpha_perf_queue.STUB_BOX, STUB_CHECKS) with the module name changed: the question is the loop's control flow; the watch and the grade are real.
leaves.cannot_prove: Anything about the clients' behaviour against an engine

leaves.name: arm-loop-box-tools
leaves.replaces: nvidia-smi, docker, systemctl and health_ok on the box

leaves.name: arm-loop-clock
leaves.replaces: Box time before the arm entry guard
leaves.equivalence: The guard compares bash SECONDS with the real LAST_ARM_ENTRY_S. Assigning SECONDS after a named step moves the variable the guard reads.
